mapper.select: SELECT sa.*, j.title AS job_title, e.company_name, w.name AS worker_name, w.phone AS worker_phone FROM schedule_applications sa LEFT JOIN jobs j ON sa.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN enterprises e ON j.company_id = e.id LEFT JOIN workers w ON sa.worker_id = w.id WHERE sa.id = #{id}

SELECT sa.*, j.title AS job_title, e.company_name, w.name AS worker_name, w.phone AS worker_phone FROM schedule_applications sa LEFT JOIN jobs j ON sa.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN enterprises e ON j.company_id = e.id LEFT JOIN workers w ON sa.worker_id = w.id WHERE sa.job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY sa.applied_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule_applications SET status = #{status}, reviewed_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
